visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top-of-page campaign message with a centered heading, supporting paragraph and primary calls to action
visualCharacteristics.layout: Single centered text column; no image on the source page, optional background image supported
elements: H1 heading (may contain a highlighted word)
two pill CTA buttons in a row

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with a background image; then one cell holding an H1 heading, a paragraph and one or more CTA links (each link alone in its own paragraph so it becomes a button)

usage: Use for a text-led campaign or page intro message that sits directly under a banner image, typically in a dark-grey section.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any centered heading + paragraph + CTA intro. For a hero with a full-bleed photo behind text, use the base hero block instead.
